Location: 

Porto Alto is a village in the parish of Samora Correia, in
the municipality of Benavente, situated in a strategic location between Lisbon

Its main feature is its excellent geographical location. It
is around 30 minutes from Lisbon, with quick access via the A10, A13 and the
Vasco da Gama Bridge, making it a highly sought-after area for families and
professionals who work in the capital but are looking for a better quality of
life and more affordable housing costs.
